verdict.rationale: Bolt's core interaction model is follow-up prompting to build/edit apps, but hands-on community reports directly contradict the 'without breaking what already works' claim: users describe a 'doom loop' of fixes resurrecting previous breaks, and one detailed account describes Bolt's AI making unauthorized changes that removed a security layer and killed payment functionality. A tip from another user (revert and re-prompt rather than trying to fix in place) further confirms iteration commonly requires workarounds rather than working smoothly. Missing for 10: first-party mechanism for safe/non-destructive iteration (e.g., diffing, checkpoints, rollback safeguards) and independent evidence that follow-up prompts reliably preserve prior functionality.
